# IPTV For Firestick USA

> IPTV service + setup guides for Amazon Firestick users in the USA. Live US
> channels and sports in 4K — every NFL feed (ESPN, FOX, CBS, NBC, NFL Network).
> Plans: $12/1 month, $25/3 months, $30/6 months, $55/year (≈ $4.58/month).
> Free 24-hour trial before any payment, no credit card. Orders, activation
> (~5 minutes) and support happen in a WhatsApp conversation, in English,
> Español or Français. Money-back guarantee. No auto-renewal, no contract.

This is a service site with guides — not a news publication. Prices are the
real prices; there are no discounts, countdowns or limited spots.

## Main sections (single page, anchor links)

- [Home](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/): overview, plans, free trial
- [Firestick setup guide](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#setup): 3-step
  install with the Downloader app, plus popular Downloader codes
- [Plans](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#premium-channels): 4 plans,
  $12–$55, activation by WhatsApp
- [NFL](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#nfl-iptv): every NFL broadcast feed,
  2026 season kickoff September 10
- [Cable vs IPTV](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#cable-vs-iptv): cost
  comparison — typical cable + sports bill ≈ $147/month ($1,764/year, July 2026
  estimate) vs $55/year
- [US channels](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#us-channels): channel
  directory by category
- [Best apps](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#apps): IPTV Smarters Pro,
  TiviMate, OTT Navigator compared
- [Troubleshooting](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#troubleshooting):
  buffering, black screen, EPG and ISP-specific fixes (Xfinity, Spectrum,
  AT&T, Verizon Fios)
- [FAQ](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#faq): 23 questions — legality,
  payment, speeds, multi-device
- [Español](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/#espanol): canales en español —
  Liga MX, Telemundo, Univision, TUDN, telenovelas; soporte en español

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/privacy)
- [Refund Policy](https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/refund): free 24-hour trial
  first; full refund within 7 days of activation if the service doesn't work
  as described and support can't fix it

## Contact

All contact is via the WhatsApp buttons on the site (English · Español ·
Français). There is no email form, no phone tree and no chat bot.
